rows.note: Use this colloquial Hong Kong term for a small step-through motor scooter rather than a human-powered or electric kick scooter.

example.english: I ride my scooter to work in the morning.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ciu4 zou2 caai2 min4 joeng2 zai2 faan1 gung1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a human-powered kick scooter.

example.english: The children ride a scooter in the park.
example.traditional: 細路仔喺公園踩滑板車。
example.jyutping: sai3 lou6 zai2 hai2 gung1 jyun2 caai2 waat6 baan2 ce1

rows.note: Use this when the kick scooter is powered by an electric motor rather than by pushing.

example.english: They rented an electric scooter to go to the waterfront.
example.traditional: 佢哋租咗部電動滑板車去海旁。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zou1 zo2 bou6 din6 dung6 waat6 baan2 ce1 heoi3 hoi2 pong4
